quotes.text: There are only two hard things in Computer Science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors.
quotes.author: Unknown (based on Phil Karlton)

quotes.text: I spent 45 minutes naming a variable today. This is fine. This is normal. I am a professional.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Naming things is easy. Naming things well is a skill. Naming things in a way that still makes sense 2 years later is a superpower.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: Globally unique human-friendly names are more trouble than they're worth. Sooner or later their referential integrity falls to corruption or neglect. We'd be better off with cryptographic hashes on the wire and user-configurable pet names in the UI.
quotes.author: __MatrixMan__
quotes.source: Hacker News — Old Bitly links are being hijacked
quotes.extraction_note: Strong anti-complexity take on a real design tradeoff — fixed typos, kept the argument intact.
